main_stats.notes: Fribbels main-stat options (SilverWolfB1.ts:353-373, a scoring list, not a simulation): Body CRIT DMG/CRIT Rate/Effect Hit Rate, Feet SPD, Sphere Quantum DMG/ATK%/HP%/DEF%, Rope Energy Regeneration Rate/ATK%/Break Effect. Smitty should decide this one.

spd_target.reason: Turn breakpoint: 20000/150 = 133.33 SPD, so 133.34 gives 2 turns in the first 150 AV cycle (src/engine/breakpoints.test.ts pins 134 as 2 turns and 133 as 1). No Fribbels SPD target exists for her (no simulation, only weights with SPD 1, SilverWolfB1.ts:339-352); already met by boots and fixed rolls.

distributed.notes: No Fribbels substat list; the scoring weights (SilverWolfB1.ts:339-352) give ATK 0.75, SPD 1, CRIT Rate 1, CRIT DMG 1, Effect Hit Rate 1. Her trace gives +10% ATK per 10% Effect Hit Rate, max +50% (kit text, kit-text.mjs 1006 --version 1; code SilverWolfB1.ts:303-318: floor(EHR/10%) steps). The trace gives 18% EHR and the 2 fixed rolls 7.8%, so 4 distributed rolls reach 41.3% (4 steps, +40% ATK); the next step is at 50%. Rolls chosen with a throwaway proxy script (damage ~ scale stat x (1 + CR x CD) x (1 + DMG%), the 2 fixed rolls per stat, the per-relic cap, simple set and trace stats only, an assumed 635 ATK / 1058 HP light cone), not with Fribbels or the kernel. Treat it as a tie-breaker, not a result. SPD: target 133.34 (K14e, turn breakpoint). 107 base + 25.032 + 4.6 = 136.632 with 0 distributed rolls (margin 3.292). Changed from the earlier draft: no change to the split. Priority: file counts (CRIT DMG 12, CRIT Rate 8, Effect Hit Rate 4), then ATK% and ATK, which her scoring weights give 0.75 each (SilverWolfB1.ts:339-352; their order is GUESS). SPD arithmetic ignores light cone and team SPD buffs.
